items.finding: 10/10 symbols fetched; provider and price basis recorded per symbol.
All price series use dividend-adjusted closes.
Missing bars forward-filled with a 5-session cap; longer gaps stay NaN and are reported.
All features use expanding or trailing windows; no centred window, no full-sample mean/std, no negative shift in any feature.
Feature scaling uses train-fold mean/std only, recomputed at each origin.
Training rows are purged when their 6M label window reaches the validation start (train_last + 126 < val_start).
An additional 126-session embargo is dropped after the purge point.
Calibrators are fitted on the validation window only; the test window is scored once and never re-fitted.
Platt, isotonic and beta are compared on validation log loss per fold; the test window plays no part in selection.
Displayed history is the union of untouched test blocks; past values are never recomputed with newer data.
Opportunity bands are fixed at 0/20/40/60/80 and were declared before any outcome was inspected; they are not fitted quantiles.
Timing Percentile uses trailing-window ranks only (5y / 10y / expanding); appending future rows does not change past values (unit-tested).
Analogue features are point-in-time z-scores; matching uses past dates only.
Nearby dates are merged into episodes and only one representative per episode is kept.
No min-max or percentile stretching is applied to the probability. It is reported in its natural 0-100 (%) units and may cluster near 70-85.
Wilson interval on the effective (non-overlapping) sample size; raw n and effective n are shown separately.
Statistical summaries use the non-overlapping monthly decision series, not the daily overlapping series.
Stooq fallback is close-only and recorded per symbol; 0 symbol(s) used it.
Newest bar is 1 day(s) old and is displayed on the dashboard.
All benchmark rules consume the walk-forward predictions; no in-sample prediction enters any benchmark.

scope_note: This audit covers methodology. Data-download checks live in the Data Audit tab and are reported separately.
